capabilities: Open .xlsx and .ods workbooks in a dedicated read-only view
Switch sheets with tabs and show sticky column letters and row numbers
Filter visible rows by searching across cell values
Report sheet count, row and column counts, and render-cap warnings
Refresh the view after the file changes outside Obsidian
extras: Read-only by design and makes no network requests. Only the first 10,000 rows of the active sheet are rendered; further rows are counted and reported. ODS previews reject archives over 32 MiB, archives with more than 4,096 entries, and content.xml over 8 MiB. Formulas are not evaluated; only cached values are shown.
motivation: Built for quick inspection of AI-generated spreadsheets, exports, and reference files inside a vault.
problem: Inspecting a spreadsheet kept in a vault otherwise means leaving Obsidian to open Excel or LibreOffice Calc.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .xlsx and .ods workbooks as value tables with sheet tabs, cell search, and a 10,000-row render limit.
